verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.127
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 3.127

verses.pali: 13. Kusināravagga
verses.english: 13. Kusinārā

verses.pali: Hatthakasutta
verses.english: With Hatthaka

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho hatthako devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṁ jetavanaṁ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā:
verses.english: Then, late at night, the glorious godling Hatthaka, lighting up the entire Jeta’s Grove, went up to the Buddha. Thinking,

verses.pali: “bhagavato purato ṭhassāmī”ti osīdatimeva saṁsīdatimeva, na sakkoti saṇṭhātuṁ.
verses.english: “I will stand before the Buddha,” he sank and melted down, and wasn’t able to stay still.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi nāma sappi vā telaṁ vā vālukāya āsittaṁ osīdatimeva saṁsīdatimeva, na saṇṭhāti;
verses.english: It’s like when ghee or oil is poured on sand, it sinks and melts down, and can’t remain stable.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ hatthako devaputto:
“bhagavato purato ṭhassāmī”ti osīdatimeva saṁsīdatimeva, na sakkoti saṇṭhātuṁ.
Atha kho bhagavā hatthakaṁ devaputtaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then the Buddha said to Hatthaka,

verses.pali: “oḷārikaṁ, hatthaka, attabhāvaṁ abhinimmināhī”ti.
verses.english: “Hatthaka, manifest a solid incarnation.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti, kho hatthako devaputto bhagavato paṭissutvā oḷārikaṁ attabhāvaṁ abhinimminitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ aṭṭhāsi.
verses.english: “Yes, sir,” replied Hatthaka. He manifested a solid incarnation, bowed to the Buddha, and stood to one side.

verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ ṭhitaṁ kho hatthakaṁ devaputtaṁ bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: The Buddha said to him,

verses.pali: “Ye te, hatthaka, dhammā pubbe manussabhūtassa pavattino ahesuṁ, api nu te te dhammā etarahi pavattino”ti?
verses.english: “Hatthaka, I wonder whether you still promulgate now the teachings that you promulgated when you were a human being?”

verses.pali: “Ye ca me, bhante, dhammā pubbe manussabhūtassa pavattino ahesuṁ, te ca me dhammā etarahi pavattino;
verses.english: “I still promulgate the teachings that I promulgated as a human being.

verses.pali: ye ca me, bhante, dhammā pubbe manussabhūtassa nappavattino ahesuṁ, te ca me dhammā etarahi pavattino.
verses.english: And I also promulgate teachings that I didn’t promulgate as a human being.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhante, bhagavā etarahi ākiṇṇo viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi;
verses.english: Just as the Buddha these days lives crowded by monks, nuns, laymen, and laywomen; by rulers and their chief ministers, and monastics of other religions and their disciples,

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho ahaṁ, bhante, ākiṇṇo viharāmi devaputtehi.
verses.english: so I live crowded by the godlings.

verses.pali: Dūratopi, bhante, devaputtā āgacchanti hatthakassa devaputtassa santike ‘dhammaṁ sossāmā’ti.
verses.english: The godlings come from far away, thinking, ‘We’ll hear the teaching in the presence of Hatthaka.’

verses.pali: Tiṇṇāhaṁ, bhante, dhammānaṁ atitto appaṭivāno kālaṅkato.
verses.english: Sir, I passed away without getting enough of three things.

verses.pali: Katamesaṁ tiṇṇaṁ?
verses.english: What three?

verses.pali: Bhagavato ahaṁ, bhante, dassanassa atitto appaṭivāno kālaṅkato;
verses.english: Seeing the Buddha;

verses.pali: saddhammasavanassāhaṁ, bhante, atitto appaṭivāno kālaṅkato;
verses.english: hearing the true teaching;

verses.pali: saṅghassāhaṁ, bhante, upaṭṭhānassa atitto appaṭivāno kālaṅkato.
verses.english: and serving the Saṅgha.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho ahaṁ, bhante, tiṇṇaṁ dhammānaṁ atitto appaṭivāno kālaṅkatoti.
verses.english: I passed away without getting enough of these three things.

verses.pali: Nāhaṁ bhagavato dassanassa,
verses.english: I could never get enough

verses.pali: Tittimajjhagā kudācanaṁ;
verses.english: of seeing the Buddha,

verses.pali: Saṅghassa upaṭṭhānassa,
verses.english: serving the Saṅgha,

verses.pali: Saddhammasavanassa ca.
verses.english: or hearing the teaching.

verses.pali: Adhisīlaṁ sikkhamāno,
verses.english: Training in the higher ethics,

verses.pali: saddhammasavane rato;
verses.english: loving to hear the true teaching,

verses.pali: Tiṇṇaṁ dhammānaṁ atitto,
verses.english: Hatthaka has gone to the Aviha realm

verses.pali: hatthako avihaṁ gato”ti.
verses.english: without getting enough of these three things.”

verses.pali: Pañcamaṁ.
